entities.summary: Tahmineh Milani (b. 1960-09-06, Tabriz) was a religious figure or clergy of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tabriz and Iran. Known in the fields of iran, architects & engineers, asia.
